info.title: aihu Agent Readiness API
info.description: Agent-readiness and discovery endpoints for aihu.dev. This is a MINIMAL, hand-authored version scoped to the static discovery files actually shipped by apps/docs today.
info.x-todo: regenerate from the docs content post-launch. The retired docs app’s openapi.json (packages/plugin-agent-readiness) additionally documented /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /.well-known/agent.json (A2A) and /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json (MCP) — none of those routes exist yet (the readiness plugin is not wired into this app). Add those paths back here only once the corresponding routes are actually served, so this document never advertises a 404.
